description: First tests of the PB(100)/water slab (ADR-0015): a 3x3 lateral supercell of the interface-1 cell, built by scripts/prep_mlmd.py from the first interface_longa frame of data/consolidado/train.xyz (training side, checked against data/consolidado.sha256). 2403 atoms, 30.261 x 30.261 x 36.002 A, Fe2/Fe3 72/72 (agent's build check 2026-11-25); same slab and water thickness as the training cell, so no environment absent from training; lateral edge > 2 x the 12 A receptive field. A test, exempt from the claim rule: --check (LAMMPS = MACE eval; timesteps/s) first, then NVT with 2 replicas; with pb_mace_v2 (Na labels with the grid error, docs/na-label-grid-error.md) it tests stability, cost and water structure, not Na physics. nsteps (100 ps at 1 fs) is revised after the check's speed. Model, LAMMPS libraries, thermostat and masses as configs/mlmd/pb_mace_v2_rdf.json (350 K, the AIMD temperature).
